description: Burgundy opaque low-square-neck gown with fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, floor-length skirt and modest front opening showing cream underlayer, gold woven neckline, center, cuffs and hem borders, decorated belt with round metal clasps and small hanging chains. Cream patterned wrap rests around both arms; earrings, pendant, bracelet and ring. Both hands together in front; decorated shoes visible, one partly hidden under hem. Full head and feet remain framed. No headgear, armor, weapon or text.
